candidates.name: Berri Downstream Pipeline
aka: Berri Increment Program crude oil pipeline
candidates.from: Aramco processing plant, Abu Ali Island
candidates.to: Khursaniyah Gas Plant and Juaymah tank farm (via expansion of the existing KRT pipeline corridor)

evidence.note: Saipem project page: EPCI of two new downstream pipelines (30-in stabilized Arabian light crude oil line + 10-in sour condensate line) connecting Aramco's Abu Ali Island processing plant to the Khursaniyah Gas Plant and Juaymah tank farm 'via expanding the existing KRT pipeline corridor,' part of the Berri Increment Program (+250 Mbcd crude); offshore pulling length >8 km; Saipem's pipeline EPCI scope shown as completed 2019-2023, but the wider Berri Increment Program (which the line serves) was still targeted for onstream by 2025 per contemporaneous project-update reporting (2024) -- so 'construction/commissioning' is the safer status read pending confirmation the increment itself is flowing.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row starts at Abu Ali Island or names the Berri Increment Program's downstream line. Nearest analogs are the Kursaniyah-Ras Tanura family (P1963/P1968/P1967/P5159, one of which is also 30-in diameter) which share the general KRT corridor concept, but those all run 'Saudi Aramco Concession->Ras Tanura' -- this line's confirmed endpoints (Abu Ali Island -> Khursaniyah Gas Plant/Juaymah tank farm) don't match any of them, and it is tied to a distinct, dated 2019-2023 capital project (Berri Increment), not a legacy KRT segment. Read as an additional parallel line in the same corridor family rather than an exact duplicate -- consolidator should check against P1963/P1968/P1967/P5159 route geometry before adding.

candidates.name: Zuluf Onshore CPF-Ju'aymah Crude Oil Pipeline
aka: Zuluf crude oil increment downstream pipeline
candidates.from: Zuluf onshore central processing facility (Tanajib-area GOSP, AH Crude Oil Increment 600 Mbcd)

evidence.note: 'New downstream pipelines will be laid to transport the crude oil to Ju'aymah terminal after the stabilisation process' from the Zuluf onshore central processing facility (600 Mbcd Arabian Heavy crude); separated gas/condensate goes to Tanajib Gas Plant via separate new pipelines.
Corroborates: stabilized crude oil from the Zuluf onshore processing facility sent to the Ju'aymah crude oil terminal via new pipelines; sponsor Saudi Aramco.

Confirms the Zuluf crude oil increment (600 Mbcd central processing facility) was still in active EPC as of mid-2024, targeting startup around 2026 -- i.e. the downstream pipeline described above is a live construction-stage project, not yet operating.

candidates.why_maybe_new: No 'Zuluf' or 'Tanajib' pipeline appears anywhere in the roster. Nearest analog is P5135 'Marjan Oil Pipeline' (100 km, 36-in, construction, endpoints unresolved '?->?') -- a comparable downstream crude line from a neighboring field development (Marjan) that may terminate at the same Tanajib/Ju'aymah complex area, but Zuluf and Marjan are distinct increment programs with separate onshore CPFs and separate EPC contract packages, so this reads as an additional line rather than a duplicate of P5135. Exact length/diameter not found in open sources -- flagged for the consolidator to seek Aramco capex disclosures or contractor EPC scope sheets if a firmer route is needed before adding.
